history.prompt: Overhead flat-lay photograph of a heavy, textured leather-bound ledger book resting beneath a modern brushed-metal solid state drive and a coiled fiber-optic cable on a dark oak desk surface. Top-down 90-degree view, illuminated by a warm, focused pool of light from an unseen architect's lamp, creating deep shadows and highlighting the weathered paper edges and gleaming metallic drive casing. Muted tones, moody forensic atmosphere, editorial elegance, generous negative space.

style_when: the story turns on one physical thing — a part, a material, a component, a document — and what that thing costs, contains or crosses a border is the news
prompt: Extreme close-up macro photograph, 100mm macro lens, one razor-sharp focal plane. An embossed, thick paper compliance ledger resting on a dark, heavy wooden forensic audit desk. Shallow depth of field, visible textured paper grain, leather binding, and dust motes. Soft directional daylight grazing the page, highlighting the tactile paper stock and subtle indentations. Hero object positioned off-centre on the right third, with the background falling away into deep, atmospheric shadows. Quiet confidence, sophisticated muted color palette, strictly no text or typography.
negative_prompt: text, words, typography, letters, numbers, watermark, logo, signature, unreadable characters, people, faces, hands
rationale: Editorial macro emphasizes the physical weight and precise scrutiny required for compliance records, turning an abstract software logging rule into a tangible, high-stakes object.
subject: embossed financial compliance ledger
composition: extreme asymmetry, hero on the right third
alt_text: Thick, textured compliance ledger resting on a dark desk under directional light, viewed in extreme close-up.
caption: Under new governance rules, the retention clock for agent audit trails can extend up to six years for financial records.
title: AI-Agent-Audit-Logs-Compliance
